patthana18.25:1.1: saraṇaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.25:2.1: araṇaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ, hetuyā. cattāri
patthana18.25:3.1: saraṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ,
patthana18.25:4.1: araṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetudhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ. hetuyā dve,
patthana18.25:5.1: saraṇaṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.25:6.1: araṇaṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ, hetuyā dve.
patthana18.25:7.1: saraṇaṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.25:8.1: araṇaṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.25:9.1: saraṇaṃ hetusampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.25:11.1: saraṇaṃ hetuñceva sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na hetu ceva na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.25:12.1: araṇaṃ hetuñceva sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu ceva na ahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ, hetuyā dve.
patthana18.25:13.1: saraṇaṃ sahetukañce na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na sahetuko ceva na na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.25:14.1: araṇaṃ sahetukañceva na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na sahetuko ceva na na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ. hetuyā dve.
patthana18.25:15.1: saraṇaṃ hetuñceva hetu sampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na hetu ceva na hetu vippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, (hetu ceva sahetuka duka sadisaṃ.)
patthana18.25:16.1: saraṇaṃ na hetuṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.25:17.1: araṇaṃ na hetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ, hetuyā dve.
patthana18.25:18.1: araṇaṃ na hetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na hetu na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
